race.comment: SOUTHERN HEIRESS (9) gets the nod after a strong first-up second here, where she came from well back and was beaten less than a length by SPIETHTACULAR. Thompson takes over from the claimer and can turn the tables with that run under the belt. SPIETHTACULAR (7) is the obvious danger, having got the job done last time and actually gets the pull at the weight with the claimer coming of SOUTHERN HEIRESS. Expect Jones to bounce straight on speed again and prove tough to reel in. DOMINANT DARCY (5) has an outstanding 1200m profile and was only beaten a length and a half first-up after being forced wide. Youngberry's claim sets her up well she's drawn the A1. BIANCELLI (3) dug deep to score by a head and pay her supporters last time. Freshened with a month between runs but has been kept up to the mark with a trial win here. BEREZKA (4) is another last start winner who's hunting the hat-trick. Can't knock.
